name: Tofu Tikka Masala
steps: Press tofu for 20 minutes and cut into 2 cm cubes. Whisk yogurt with half the ginger-garlic, half the chili, 3 g garam masala, lemon juice and 4 g salt; coat tofu and marinate 20 minutes.
Spread tofu on a lined tray, brush with 15 ml oil and roast at 220°C for 18–20 minutes, turning once, until the edges char lightly.

Meanwhile heat remaining oil in a pan. Cook onion 8 minutes until golden; add remaining ginger-garlic for 1 minute. Stir in tomato puree, coriander powder, remaining chili and salt; cook 9 minutes until thick.
Add 180 ml water and simmer sauce for 5 minutes. Lower the heat, stir in cream and remaining garam masala, and keep just below a boil.
Fold roasted tofu into the sauce and warm 2 minutes, preserving the charred edges. Sprinkle coriander and serve with rice or roti.
tips: For a dairy-free version, use unsweetened plant yogurt and coconut cream in the same quantities.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
